sentences.japanese: 恐ろしさが私の心に忍び込み、そこに残った。
sentences.english: Fear crept into my heart and settled there.

sentences.japanese: 泥棒が窓から忍び込んだ。
sentences.english: A thief crept in through the window.

sentences.japanese: そんな場面を見るに忍びなかった。
sentences.english: I couldn't bear to see such a scene.

sentences.japanese: そのふたりの男はその家に忍び込むのが目撃された。
sentences.english: The two men were seen to steal into the house.

sentences.japanese: こっそり家に忍び込む。
